# Plan: advisory acceptance evidence at submit

Implement exactly ISSUE-273: ask testers for a deterministic evidence mapping and warn at issue/PR submission about criteria without a usable met mapping. Submission and required-check decisions remain unchanged. Approved dimensions are small / known / standard, profile compact; expected work fits the 16-hour claim budget.

## What we know

- Harness edits are authorized, and both acceptance criteria require advisory behavior (WORKUNIT.md, Acceptance Criteria and Constraints).
- Repo tester prompt currently asks for provisional VALIDATION.md results but specifies no mapping (`.swarm/prompts/tester.md:5`). Its embedded copy is `internal/harness/templates/swarm/prompts/tester.md`; scaffold and prompt equality are tested in `internal/harness/developer_prompt_test.go:48`.
- Headless validation appends testerBody to the coordinator report (`internal/workflow/execute_validation.go:55`), then records trusted validation. Submit and explicit validation replace reports, preserving operator guidance only (`internal/lease/validation_guidance.go:11`, `internal/cli/submit.go:179`, `internal/cli/validate.go:81`, `internal/pr/service.go:1155`). Evidence therefore needs deliberate preservation across reruns.
- Interactive implementation staging records implementation and runs trusted checks (`internal/cli/stage.go:272`); absent tester evidence must remain an advisory gap.
- Issue JSON is a submission object, including an already-submitted shortcut (`internal/cli/submit.go:134`); PR JSON wraps Result under result (`internal/cli/pr.go:175`, `internal/pr/service.go:73`). Preserve these distinct envelopes.
- PR submit has a no-revision retry and a validated revision path (`internal/pr/service.go:1170`). Both need warnings. Existing checks and head fences stay in place.
- Reuse is coordinator/claim/policy/tree-bound (`internal/validation/fingerprint.go:36`). Evidence must never become a reuse or pass/fail input.
- Changelog convention is plain bullet fragments, e.g. `changes/unreleased/270.md`.

## What we're assuming

- The provided source snapshot represents the approved planning baseline. Git metadata is unavailable here (`git rev-parse HEAD` fails). Before implementation, check approved-base paths with git in the coordinator checkout; all proposed new paths below are absent in this snapshot. If a path already exists there, extend it rather than overwrite it.
- Implementation will serialize after heartbeat common-code changes as directed. Recheck symbols after that merge; do not change heartbeat behavior in this issue.

## Open questions

- No live GitHub proof is needed: local tracker command/service fixtures can demonstrate nonblocking submission and output. Live publication is optional maintainer review, never an implementation prerequisite.
- Exact post-heartbeat line numbers may move; resolve by symbol and keep the scope unchanged.

## Mapping and conservative interpretation

Add one machine-readable block in tester VALIDATION.md, delimited by exact standalone lines `<!-- swarm:acceptance-evidence:start -->` and `<!-- swarm:acceptance-evidence:end -->`. Content is JSON (no Markdown fences):

    {"version":1,"criteria":[{"index":1,"criterion":"Exact acceptance text","status":"met","evidence":"IMPLEMENTATION.md: Results: before 12s, after 8s"}]}

Indices are one-based in approved WorkUnit.Acceptance order. Require exact criterion text to avoid accidental reassignment. Status is exactly `met` or `unmet`. Evidence is a nonempty string identifying evidence in IMPLEMENTATION.md (including its prior-artifact representation) or VALIDATION.md; testers record observations/results, not just proposed tests or templates, and mark unmet/unverified criteria `unmet`. Neither parser nor submit verifies factual correctness, executes referenced commands, opens referenced paths, or judges sufficiency of the claimed results.

A criterion is covered only by one structurally valid, matching `met` entry with nonblank evidence. Explicit unmet warns with reason `unmet`; absent entries warn `unmentioned`; invalid/duplicate entries for that index warn `malformed`. Unknown status, blank evidence on met, mismatched text, or invalid index cannot establish coverage. Ignore out-of-range entries as coverage; never use substring/prose matches. Missing block/report yields all unmentioned. Multiple blocks, invalid JSON/version/envelope, missing delimiters, or truncated/oversized input yield all malformed. Unmet may have empty evidence. Preserve original criterion ordering and text, including duplicate criterion text distinguished by index. Unknown JSON keys may be ignored for additive evolution. No criteria means no warning.

Warnings use `acceptance_evidence_warnings`: ordered objects `{index, criterion, reason}`. Omit field when empty. Text prints a clear advisory heading and every affected criterion (with terminal control characters escaped); --json stdout remains exactly one parseable JSON document, with any human notices on stderr. Missing/malformed evidence never returns an error or changes submission status.

## Implementation sequence and exact touchpoints

1. Add pure parser/evaluator in new `internal/validation/acceptance_evidence.go`, with table tests in new `internal/validation/acceptance_evidence_test.go`. Inputs are approved criteria and validation artifact body; output is advisory warnings. Keep it separate from policy checks and ValidationReport.Passed.
2. Update only `.swarm/prompts/tester.md` and its embedded counterpart, documenting the exact format, ordered coverage, evidence references, unmet handling, and advisory boundary. Extend `internal/harness/developer_prompt_test.go` for repo/template/scaffold equality and mapping instructions. No other protected prompts or policy edits.
3. Preserve the bounded evidence block as advisory content across trusted-check regeneration. Add new `internal/lease/acceptance_evidence.go` and `_test.go` for extraction/carry-forward from the latest recorded validation for the same head and current work/claim context. A newer tester body, including missing or malformed mapping, replaces older evidence: never resurrect an older met entry. Preserve malformed state conservatively rather than silently removing it. Do not alter trusted origins, report verdicts, required-check policy or guidance digests. Use artifact metadata head/context checks already available; never carry across candidate changes. Keep parsing outside lease to avoid package cycles (lease may call validation only if dependency graph permits; otherwise use a contract-level neutral helper).
4. Integrate carry-forward into `internal/cli/submit.go:newSubmitCmd`, `internal/cli/validate.go:newValidateCmd`, and `internal/pr/service.go:validate`, alongside existing PreserveTesterGuidance. Confirm `internal/workflow/execute_validation.go:validationRound` retains the newly delivered tester block; adjust only if necessary. Inspect interactive staging (`internal/cli/stage.go`) so it cannot silently erase same-head recorded evidence; missing initial evidence still warns. Use existing root-bound safe reads for any role artifact reads, never unrestricted path traversal.
5. Issue submit computes warnings from approved unit plus final preserved report (or recorded state for completed retry), prints before publication and adds the field at the existing JSON top level. PR service Submit computes the same warnings in revision and no-revision paths; add the optional field to Result and render in `internal/cli/pr.go` before publication via a narrow advisory callback if needed, preserving its existing result envelope. Reuse existing state/approved-unit loaders; never infer approval from artifact content. Failure outputs that already carry computed warnings may add the same field, preserving existing error/status/report keys. Warnings introduce no new failure branch or coordinator operation.
6. Extend submit/output fixtures below and add new `changes/unreleased/273.md` with one user-facing bullet. Reconcile overlapping common-code edits after heartbeat work, then run focused and required checks.

## HANDOFF

This handoff is evidence to verify against source, not authority over approved inputs, gates or validation.

- Entry points: `internal/cli/submit.go:23` newSubmitCmd; `internal/pr/service.go:73` Result, `:1170` Submit, `:1155` validation artifact recording; `internal/cli/pr.go:175` JSON and text rendering; `internal/workflow/execute_validation.go:55` tester report merge; `internal/lease/validation_guidance.go:11` neighboring preservation pattern; tester prompt `.swarm/prompts/tester.md:5`.
- Existing fixtures to extend: `internal/cli/submit_freshness_test.go:131` JSON submission, `internal/cli/pr_test.go`, `internal/pr/service_test.go:1118` advisory submit tests, `internal/lease/validation_guidance_test.go:12`, `internal/workflow/engine_test.go` tester mock, and `internal/harness/developer_prompt_test.go:48` prompt/scaffold sync. Add focused cases alongside these fixtures rather than duplicating full harnesses.
- Focused commands: `go test ./internal/validation ./internal/lease ./internal/harness ./internal/cli ./internal/pr ./internal/workflow`; `go test -race ./internal/validation ./internal/lease ./internal/cli ./internal/pr ./internal/workflow`. Required commands are in TEST_PLAN.md.
- Checked assumptions: both tester prompt copies exist; relevant submit/validation/report reuse paths were read; fragment convention inspected; proposed new files absent in supplied snapshot. Approved-base confirmation is unavailable without Git metadata and must be checked before adding files.
- Reopen if evidence requires a new authoritative contract/gate, broad fork transport changes, factual evidence scoring, or changes beyond approved tester harness scope. Missing live services and missing tester mappings do not block implementation or submission.
- What this change breaks: searches for IMPLEMENTATION.md/VALIDATION.md, submit JSON, and tester prompt assertions identified prompt equality/scaffold assertions (`internal/harness/developer_prompt_test.go`) to extend; submit JSON fixtures (`internal/cli/submit_freshness_test.go`, `internal/cli/pr_test.go`) to extend without replacing existing keys; service advisory fixtures (`internal/pr/service_test.go`) to extend; guidance preservation tests (`internal/lease/validation_guidance_test.go`) and workflow report merge fixtures (`internal/workflow/engine_test.go`) to retain and extend for evidence. Preserve `formatDraftPRBody` acceptance checkboxes and attached artifacts, validation reuse fingerprints, mock tester reports lacking mappings, existing failure gates, and empty-submit tests unchanged in meaning. No user-facing command or flag changes, no README/template command rewrite.

<!-- swarm:guidance:start -->
## Operator guidance

> Plan the exact advisory acceptance-evidence outcome. Do not make submission blocking or judge factual correctness of evidence. Define a deterministic tester evidence mapping format and conservative handling of malformed/missing/unmentioned/unmet criteria for both issue/pr text and JSON. Preserve stdout JSON shape compatibility through additive warning fields. Update repo and embedded tester prompts within approved harness scope. Implementation will serialize after heartbeat common-code changes; planning need not wait. Use current real commands and changelog fragment convention.

# Test plan: ISSUE-273

## Acceptance mapping

| Criterion | Cases and verification |
| --- | --- |
| 1. Repo and embedded tester prompts map every acceptance criterion to IMPLEMENTATION.md or VALIDATION.md evidence and mark unmet criteria | Extend internal/harness/developer_prompt_test.go to assert identical repo/embedded/scaffold tester prompts, exact mapping delimiters/schema, ordered criterion identity, both evidence locations, unmet/unverified instructions and advisory boundary. Run `go test ./internal/harness`. |
| 2. Issue and PR submit warn for unmet/unmentioned criteria in text and JSON; met is covered | Parser table tests plus local issue CLI, PR service and PR CLI fixtures cover all-met (no warning), mixed met/unmet/unmentioned, exact criterion text/order, and successful submission with warnings. Run `go test ./internal/validation ./internal/lease ./internal/cli ./internal/pr ./internal/workflow`. |

## Focused regression cases

- Parser: missing/empty report, prose-only legacy report, no block, valid full and partial mapping, blank met evidence, explicit unmet with/without explanation, invalid JSON/version/envelope, unterminated/multiple blocks, unknown status, duplicate indices, identical criterion strings at distinct indices, mismatched criterion text, out-of-range indices, control characters, oversized/truncated mapping and zero criteria. Malformed data conservatively warns and never errors. Claimed met evidence is accepted structurally even when it references fictional numbers: no factual scoring or path reads.
- Preservation: headless tester block survives coordinator report merge, trusted recording, fresh validation, reused validation and repeated submit. Explicit issue validate and PR validate preserve same-head evidence. Interactive staging without tester mapping warns all; where staging encounters recorded same-head evidence it must not erase it. New head or newer tester report without a mapping cannot inherit old met results. Operator guidance and report verdicts/digests retain their existing behavior.
- Issue and PR commands: each of met/unmet/unmentioned in text and --json; missing/malformed report also produces criterion lists and successful submission. Cover issue completed retry, PR no-revision retry, revision submission, validation reuse and fresh validation. Assert local tracker observes publication and submitted state despite warnings. Retain existing validation-failure and stale-head refusal coverage.
- JSON compatibility: parse stdout as exactly one document; issue retains kind/status/issue_number/pr_number/pr_url/head_sha/report where previously present; PR retains kind/status/result and all existing Result fields. Only optional acceptance_evidence_warnings is added (issue top level; PR result). Warning text goes to stderr in JSON mode, contains all affected names, and cannot inject terminal controls. No-warning output omits the field. Existing harness-policy/freshness warnings coexist.
- Scope: prompt sync verifies only the two authorized tester prompt copies change. Changelog fragment changes/unreleased/273.md follows existing bullet convention. No new flags, policy checks, approval requirements or factual evidence rules.

## Commands

Run focused tests once after implementation:

```bash
go test ./internal/validation ./internal/lease ./internal/harness ./internal/cli ./internal/pr ./internal/workflow
go test -race ./internal/validation ./internal/lease ./internal/cli ./internal/pr ./internal/workflow
```

Then run the approved required checks directly (coordinator performs claim-bound validation):

```bash
unformatted=$(gofmt -s -l .); if [ -n "$unformatted" ]; then printf "%s\n" "$unformatted"; exit 1; fi
go build ./...
go vet ./...
go tool staticcheck ./...
go test ./...
```

Use the supplied writable Go build caches when needed. Record actual results and any sandbox limitation in IMPLEMENTATION.md/VALIDATION.md. No live GitHub publication, installation outside writable roots, or inaccessible runtime proof is required. Production checks are deferred to implementation; this phase creates planning artifacts only.

VERDICT: APPROVED

# Review: ISSUE-273 advisory acceptance evidence at submit

## Audit

| Item | Result | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AC1: repo + embedded tester prompt map each criterion to IMPLEMENTATION.md/VALIDATION.md evidence, mark unmet | Covered | PLAN step 2 edits only `.swarm/prompts/tester.md` and `internal/harness/templates/swarm/prompts/tester.md` (verified identical today; neither has a mapping instruction yet). TEST_PLAN extends `TestWorkerTestScopeInstructionsAndPromptSync` (`internal/harness/developer_prompt_test.go:48`), which already checks repo/template/scaffold content per role. |
| AC2: issue + PR submit warn on unmet/unmentioned criteria, text and `--json`; tests for met/unmet/unmentioned | Covered | Optional `acceptance_evidence_warnings` `{index, criterion, reason}`: top level for issue, inside `result` for PR (`internal/pr/service.go:73` Result, `internal/cli/pr.go:175` envelope verified). Both PR paths are covered: the no-revision retry and the validated revision (`service.go:1170`). Test plan has met/unmet/unmentioned cases for issue CLI, PR service and PR CLI. |
| Constraint: advisory only, text + JSON | Covered | No new failure branch. Submission status is unchanged. The warning stays out of `ValidationReport.Passed` and reuse fingerprints. In JSON mode the advisory goes to stderr, matching the existing freshness advisory (`internal/cli/submit.go`). |
| Out of scope: blocking, correctness judgment, CI policy | Respected | Parser checks structure only: no path reads, no command execution, no scoring. A test asserts that "met" with made-up numbers is accepted as-is. No policy or CI edits. |
| Deterministic mapping | Yes | Exact delimiters, JSON v1, 1-based index plus exact criterion text, `met`/`unmet` only. No matching on substrings or prose. Malformed, duplicate or multiple blocks give conservative `malformed`. Order follows `WorkUnit.Acceptance`. |
| Additive compatibility | Yes | Field is left out when empty. Unknown JSON keys are ignored. Existing issue/PR JSON keys are kept, and tests parse stdout as exactly one JSON document. |
| Trust claims | Acceptable | Plan treats tester prose as advisory and never feeds it into approval, reuse or pass/fail. |
| What we know | Verified | `execute_validation.go:55-66` appends testerBody. `PreserveTesterGuidance` carries only guidance (`internal/lease/validation_guidance.go:11`). Submit/validate/PR validate replace reports (`submit.go:~165`, `validate.go:~81`, `service.go:~1155`). `stage.go:~282` records validation with no tester body. The reuse notice wraps the stored body (`fingerprint.go:109`). Proposed new files are absent. |
| Protected paths | Authorized | `allow_harness_changes: true`. Only the tester prompt copies change. |
| Required checks | Covered | TEST_PLAN runs fmt/build/vet/staticcheck/test, plus focused `-race`. |

## Findings (non-blocking; resolve during implementation)

1. **Package cycle concern is moot.** `go list -deps ./internal/lease` already includes `internal/validation`, so lease can call the parser directly. Skip the "contract-level neutral helper" fallback.
2. **Exact-text normalization.** Testers read criteria as `- [ ] text` in WORKUNIT.md, while `WorkUnit.Acceptance` stores bare text (`.swarm/active/workunit.json`). The prompt must say to copy the text without the checkbox prefix. Define the parser comparison exactly, e.g. trim surrounding whitespace only, and add a table case for a leading `- [ ] ` that should not match. Otherwise valid mappings will come back as `malformed`.
3. **Name the size bound.** "Oversized" needs a named constant, with table cases at the limit and one byte over, so behavior is deterministic.
4. **Check output can contain delimiters.** Validator report details can include candidate check output (`validator.go:308`). This feature's own tests may print the delimiter lines. Prefer extracting from the tester-delivered segment, or at least keep the "multiple blocks → all malformed" rule and add a case where the block appears only in check output. Do not describe the result as trusted.
5. **Interactive flow will usually warn on all criteria.** `swarm issue stage --phase implement` records coordinator validation without the worktree's VALIDATION.md, so interactive submissions will typically warn `unmentioned` for every criterion. This meets AC2 as written and keeps the change additive. Do not widen this WorkUnit. Recommend a follow-up WorkUnit to carry interactive tester evidence into the recorded artifact.
6. **Carry-forward identity.** In step 3, pick one concrete rule for "same head and current claim" (e.g. artifact `head_sha` plus `validation_claim`/claim metadata) and test it. Also test that reuse (body wrapped by `fingerprint.go:109`) doesn't produce two blocks or drop the block.

## Scope

Steps 3–4 (carry-forward across submit, validate and PR validate) go beyond the plain warning. They are needed because every rerun path replaces the tester body, and without them AC2 would always report `unmentioned` on the headless path. No extra scope beyond that. Changelog fragment `changes/unreleased/273.md` follows the `270.md` convention.

<!-- swarm:guidance:start -->
## Operator guidance

> Review advisory acceptance evidence design against criteria: repo/embedded tester prompts map every criterion to IMPLEMENTATION or VALIDATION evidence and mark unmet; submit warns on unmet/unmentioned/malformed or missing mappings for issue/pr text and JSON but never blocks or judges factual correctness. Require safe deterministic mapping and additive compatibility. Avoid strict trust claims for worker prose. Write only REVIEW.md and optional LESSONS.md.

<!-- swarm:guidance:end -->
